item.title: Special Issue Proposals
item.content:encoded:
The Journal of Consumer Behaviour has put in place a new process for proposing new Special Issues. Authors wishing to propose a Special Issue should follow the procedure outlined and fill in the attached application form.

Timeline

  • August 1, 2025: Application submission window for Special Issue Proposals
  • August 15, 2025: Submission deadline for Special Issue Proposal applications
